 Prayer:- Writ petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution o
 praying for issuance of a writ of Mandamus, directing the respondent
 consider the representation dated 16.07.202 and to cancel all the
 fraudulently registered documents with regard to the plot nos. 1809,
 and 2375 in Ganapathi Phase-1, Lig-1 in Tamil Nadu Housing Board,
 Coimbatore Division, Coimbatore and to register those plots in favou
 the petitioner, within a stipulated period.
 For Petitioner : Mr.P.Thinesh
 For Respondents : Mr.Yogesh Kannadasan, Spl
 : Mr.A.M.Ravindranath Jeyap
 for R.2 to R.4.
 Order

This writ petition has been filed for the following relief:-
directing the respondents to consider the representation dated 16.07.202 and to cancel all the fraudulently registered documents with regard to the plot nos. 1809,
466 and 2375 in Ganapathi Phase-1, LIG-1 in Tamil Nadu Housing Board,
Coimbatore Division, Coimbatore and to register those plots in favour of the petitioner, within a stipulated period. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

The petitioners case is that she along with her husband is the owner of the Plot Nos.1809, 466 and 2375 in Ganapathi Phase-1, LIG-1 in Tamil Nadu Housing Board, Coimbatore Division,
Coimbatore.

6. Considering the limited request of the petitioner and taking note of the fact the petitioners representation dated 16.07.2025 has not been considered to date, the Writ Petition is allowed.

The 2 respondent is directed to consider the petitioners representation dated 16.07.2025 and dispose of the same on merits and in accordance with law, after affording an opportunity of hearing to all the interested parties, within a period of 3 months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
No costs.
